description: Reports what each ad brought, as Marsell itself counted it, for the last days: per ad and per campaign, the visits it sent, the accounts opened, the paid subscriptions and their money (refunds taken off), against what the ad spent, with the cost of each result; beside it, what the network itself claims, which is never added to Marsell's count. Then every ad visit and every result with where it came from, and whether results go back to Google. counting.on false: Marsell does not count this business's results yet, and why; the spend and the network's own numbers are still there. Read it when the owner asks what an ad or campaign brought, or before saying an ad worked; it spends nothing. Every ad on Sell with what it spends this month is place_open sell.
